findings.evidence: check_url('http://%D1%80aypal.com/') -> HOST_INVALID (a WHATWG browser decodes it to 'раураl.com'), on user URLs, search hits and redirects. A redirect with Location 'http://ｐａｙｐａｌ.com/' (UTF-8) gives fetch_status UNREACHABLE with refusal_code None, because httpx raises RemoteProtocolError 'Invalid IDNA hostname' while reading the response, before check_url runs. In both cases the host is never contacted (verified with MockTransport), but blocked_non_english stays 0 and the D21 note is missing.
findings.suggested_fix: In check_url, when the host contains '%', percent-decode it and refuse with HOST_NON_ENGLISH if the result is non-ASCII. In safe_fetch, read the raw Location header (or catch the httpx redirect URL error) so the target goes through check_url.
findings.title: Percent-encoded or httpx-rejected non-English hosts are refused without HOST_NON_ENGLISH, so they are not counted and no reason is shown
